::: {#sol-lora-count}

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
full_count = 768 * 768
low_rank_count = 768 * 8 + 8 * 768
print(full_count, low_rank_count, low_rank_count / full_count)
```

$\matr{B}$ and $\matr{A}$ hold `r format(py$low_rank_count, big.mark = ",")` numbers between them,
`r sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * py$low_rank_count / py$full_count)` of the `r format(py$full_count, big.mark = ",")` in $\matr{W}$.
The product $\matr{B}\matr{A}$ is still a $768 \times 768$ matrix,
but its rank is at most 8.

:::
